Introduction
This document lists the 
major maintenance procedures 
equipment P2, which must be performed every 
twelve years as indicated by Y12 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Hamdy Abd El 
Hamid Fouda, reviewed eng. Mahmoud Abd El Hamid El kholy, tested by eng. Saad El 
Saeed Rageh, approved by general director eng.Yousry Ahmed Abd El Maksoud 
accepted by eng. Awad Fathy head sector of Talkha PS , certified by accountant

director , and supervisor of EDEPCO inspection and quality controls head 
sector , reviewed by EDEPC inspection and 
quality control eng. Adel Abd El-Qader El-Nagar and accepted by 
Samir Abd El-Gilil, EDEPC MPIS coordinator
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by any one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc.
Generator isolation 
 and proper earthing is required.
Ensure that the circuit breaker disconnected 
 and secondary disconnect.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes
Complete tool set, brushes
Megger, digital voltmeter
